incidents.summary: Smiths Detection faced a proposed employee class action alleging unpaid wages and meal and rest break violations, which remained in federal court.

sources.title: Smiths Detection Employee’s Wage Suit Proceeds in Federal Court
sources.quote: Security-tech company Smiths Detection Inc. convinced a federal judge in California to retain jurisdiction over an employee’s proposed class action alleging state law wage and breaks violations.

sources.title: Smiths Detection Employee’s Wage Suit Proceeds in Federal Court
sources.quote: In addition to the alleged break violations, the lawsuit claims that Smiths failed to pay all regular and overtime wages owed, and timely pay final wages.

sources.title: Smiths Detection Employee’s Wage Suit Proceeds in Federal Court
sources.quote: The company established that the case is worth about $5.3 million based on its payroll data and reasonable assumptions about the number of violations experienced by each potential class member

incidents.summary: Smiths Group’s John Crane unit remained a co-defendant in litigation concerning legacy asbestos-containing products, while Smiths launched a process to sell its US asbestos liability.

sources.title: UK's Smiths Group beats profit forecasts, seeks sale of US asbestos liability | live
sources.quote: Smiths' John Crane unit is among numerous co-defendants in litigation relating to legacy products that contained asbestos.

sources.title: UK's Smiths Group beats profit forecasts, seeks sale of US asbestos liability | live
sources.quote: The company had set aside £153 million in fiscal 2026 to cover expected future legal costs and adverse judgements, down from £191 million a year earlier.

sources.title: UK's Smiths Group beats profit forecasts, seeks sale of US asbestos liability | live
sources.quote: British engineering firm Smiths Group beat expectations with its full-year operating profit on Tuesday and launched a process to sell its US asbestos liability

incidents.summary: Smiths Group reported unauthorised access to its systems and isolated affected systems while working with experts to recover them and assess wider impacts.

sources.title: UK engineering firm Smiths Group hit by cyber attack | WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM | Wausau, Stevens Point
sources.quote: British engineering firm Smiths Group is managing a cybersecurity incident that involved unauthorised access to its systems, the company said on Tuesday

sources.title: UK engineering firm Smiths Group hit by cyber attack | WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM | Wausau, Stevens Point
sources.quote: The company, best known for making baggage-screening kits and explosive detectors, said it had isolated the affected systems when it became aware of the incident.

sources.title: UK engineering firm Smiths Group hit by cyber attack | WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM | Wausau, Stevens Point
sources.quote: Smiths Group said it was working with experts to recover its systems and to determine any wider impact.
